# Zoa command help -- generated by help/gen_docs.py from the !## docblocks.
# Do not edit; edit the docblocks in the source and re-run the script.

#CMD !
#ALS !
#SYN ! text
#CAT Utilities
#DES Comment line (ignored); used in .zoa files.

#CMD ADW
#ALS ADW
#SYN ADW [TIL|FOC] x_tilt [y_tilt [focus [piston]]]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA: add tilt, focus (rho^2) and piston to the wavefront, in waves at the pupil edge; TIL removes the best-fit tilt first, FOC the best-fit tilt and focus.  ADW 0 turns it off.

#CMD AFC
#ALS AFC
#SYN AFC [Yes|No]
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Afocal (Yes) or focal (No) evaluation mode; bare AFC shows the mode.

#CMD AIRY
#ALS AIRY
#SYN AIRY ON | OFF
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Spot diagram: overlay the Airy disk on every field point. Draws a black circle of radius 1.22*lambda*F/#, using the working (image-space) F-number.  Off by default.  While it is on the plot is scaled squarely so the disk is a circle.

#CMD ANN
#ALS ANN
#SYN ANN RMS|SPO [Y|N]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES SPO: annotate each spot with its RMS size (ANN RMS, on by default) and its full diameter, 100% of the rays about the centroid (ANN SPO, off by default).  ANN LEN / ANN INI are not available.

#CMD AOI
#ALS AOI
#SYN AOI Sk [Ri] [Fk] = v | AOI Sk [Ri] [Fk] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Angle of incidence (deg) of reference ray Ri (default R1) of field k (default F1) at Sk. AOR: angle of refraction.

#CMD APE
#ALS APE
#SYN APE [Sk|Si..j|SA] [F] [CLR|EDG|OBS]
#CAT Apertures
#DES List the apertures of surfaces Sk..j (all by default): clear apertures (CLR), edges (EDG) and obscurations (OBS) -- shape, Y and X semi-widths, decenters and rotation.  F numbers them.

#CMD ASP
#ALS ASP
#SYN ASP Sk
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Make surface Sk an asphere type.  If in lens editor mode or when loading a lens will operate on the current surface

#CMD AST
#ALS AST
#SYN AST x
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES FIE plot: field-curvature x-axis spans -x..+x (0 = autoscale). The legacy astigmatism-table command is now ASTK.

#CMD AST3
#ALS AST3
#SYN AST3 = v | AST3 v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Third-order astigmatism sum merit entry (the AST3 SUM shown by THO).

#CMD ASTFLD
#ALS ASTFLD
#SYN ASTFLD X | Y
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Select the field direction for the astigmatism plot.

#CMD ATC
#ALS ATC
#SYN ATC Sk = v | ATC Sk v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Center thickness after Sk divided by the diameter.

#CMD ATE
#ALS ATE
#SYN ATE Sk = v | ATE Sk v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Edge thickness after Sk divided by the diameter.

#CMD AUT
#ALS AUT
#SYN AUT ; <constraints/operands> ; GO
#CAT Optimization
#DES Run local optimization; define operands and constraints inside the loop.

#CMD AUTUI
#ALS AUTUI
#SYN AUTUI
#CAT Optimization
#DES Open the optimizer setup window (merit operands, constraints, variables).

#CMD AX
#ALS AX
#SYN AX [Wj] [Wm] = v | AX [Wj] [Wm] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Axial colour: paraxial image distance at Wj minus at Wm (default W1 and the last wavelength).

#CMD AZI
#ALS AZI
#SYN AZI a
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Set the azimuth angle of the 3D lens view.

#CMD BES
#ALS BES
#SYN BES
#CAT Lens System Commands
#DES Find the best-focus image thickness (minimum RMS).

#CMD BRE
#ALS BRE
#SYN BRE Sk
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Break the cemented interface at Sk: insert, ahead of Sk, a surface of the same shape (curvature, conic, asphere) with zero air space after it.

#CMD CA
#ALS CA
#SYN CA YES|NO|APE
#CAT Apertures
#DES Whether the entered apertures are used: YES (default) they block rays, NO the ray trace ignores them, APE entered apertures only (the same as YES here).  The lens drawing always shows them.

#CMD CAN
#ALS CAN
#SYN CAN
#CAT Utilities
#DES Cancel the open option (a plot, AUT, ...) without running it (CODE V CAN).

#CMD CCY
#ALS CCY
#SYN CCY Sk n | CCY Si..j n
#CAT Optimization
#DES Set the YZ-curvature variable code on surface(s).

#CMD CHA
#ALS CHA
#SYN CHA n ; <value>
#CAT Optimization
#DES Change entry n inside the current UPD loop.

#CMD CIR
#ALS CIR
#SYN CIR [Sk] r
#CAT Apertures
#DES Set a circular clear aperture of radius r on surface Sk (CIR EDG for an edge aperture).

#CMD CLI
#ALS CLI
#SYN CLI
#CAT Apertures
#DES Check/refresh the clear apertures.

#CMD CON
#ALS CON
#SYN CON [SUP] [Y|N]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA: contour lines over the map, numbered (CON Y) or not (CON SUP Y).

#CMD COP
#ALS COP
#SYN COP Sk|Si..j Sn
#CAT Lens System Commands
#DES Copy surfaces Sk..j of the lens and insert the copies ahead of Sn: curvature, thickness, glass, conic and aspheric terms, apertures, decenters.  Solves and pickups are not copied (they refer to other surfaces).  Copying from a library lens is not available.

#CMD CSO
#ALS CSO
#SYN CSO [catalog ...]
#CAT Glass Catalogs
#DES Sets the catalog search order: a glass named without its catalog is looked up in these catalogs first, in this order (the other catalogs follow alphabetically).  CSO alone restores the default order (LIBGLA/catalog-order.txt); CSO ? shows the current order.  The order lasts for the session.

#CMD CT
#ALS CT
#SYN CT Sk = v | CT Sk v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Center thickness after surface Sk.

#CMD CUX
#ALS CUX
#SYN CUX Sk <qual> j
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Sets an XZ (X-toric) curvature solve on surface Sk.  Qualifiers: AMX (aplanatic marginal, KDP APX), ACX (aplanatic chief, APCX), IMX j (angle of incidence, PIX), ICX j (PICX), UMX j (ray slope, PUX), UCX j (PUCX).

#CMD CUY
#ALS CUY
#SYN CUY Sk X  |  CUY Sk <qual> j
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Sets the YZ curvature (1/radius) on surface Sk to X. Sk can be S0 (object), S1..SN (surface by number), or Si (current surface). A solve qualifier sets a curvature solve instead: AMY (aplanatic marginal, KDP APY), ACY (aplanatic chief, APCY), IMY j (angle of incidence, PIY), ICY j (PICY), UMY j (ray slope, PUY), UCY j (PUCY).

#CMD CX
#ALS CX
#SYN CX
#CAT Analysis
#DES Print chief-ray X data.

#CMD CY
#ALS CY
#SYN CY
#CAT Analysis
#DES Print chief-ray Y data.

#CMD DAR
#ALS BEN DAR RET REV
#SYN DAR|BEN|REV [Sk|Si..j] | RET [Sk] Sj
#CAT Tilts and Decenters
#DES Decenter type of surface Sk (default: the current surface): DAR decenter-and-return, BEN decenter-and-bend (mirrors), REV reversed decenter, RET return to the coordinate system of surface Sj. DEL DDA|DAR|BEN|REV Sk|Si..j removes them.

#CMD DCON
#ALS DCON
#SYN DCON n
#CAT Optimization
#DES Delete constraint/operand number n.

#CMD DDR
#ALS DDR
#SYN DDR [EDG f | ?]
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Default drawing rules: EDG f = default edge aperture as f times the clear aperture.

#CMD DEL
#ALS DEL
#SYN DEL PIM | DEL SOL <verb> Sk | DEL CON n | DEL VIG
#CAT Lens System Commands
#DES Delete user-defined system data: PIM/thickness solves, angle/curvature solves (DEL SOL CUY|CUX|THI Sk), a constraint (DEL CON n), or vignetting.

#CMD DEL
#ALS DEL
#SYN DEL pupil_increment
#CAT Optimization
#DES AUT: the CDV ray grid spacing in pupil fractions (default 0.385, or 0.22 when the lens has aspheric surfaces).  DEL 0 restores it.

#CMD DEZ
#ALS DEZ
#SYN DEZ k
#CAT Zoom / Multi-Configuration
#DES Dezoom: keep zoom position k as the (single-configuration) lens and remove the zoom data.

#CMD DIM
#ALS DIM
#SYN DIM M|C|I
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Set the lens units: M (mm), C (cm), or I (inches).

#CMD DIS
#ALS DIS
#SYN DIS [INT] [Y|N]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA: colour map (DIS Y, the default), interferogram fringes (DIS INT Y, one fringe per wave) or none (DIS N, for contours alone).

#CMD DIY
#ALS DIY
#SYN DIY [Fk] = v | DIY [Fk] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Distortion fraction (0.05 = 5%) of field k, Y coordinate (default the last field). DIX for X.

#CMD DRAWSF
#ALS DRAWSF
#SYN DRAWSF Sk
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Set the last surface drawn in the lens view.

#CMD DRAWSI
#ALS DRAWSI
#SYN DRAWSI Sk
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Set the first surface drawn in the lens view.

#CMD DST
#ALS DST
#SYN DST x
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES FIE plot: distortion x-axis spans -x%..+x% (0 = autoscale).

#CMD EDI
#ALS EDI
#SYN EDI PREF
#CAT Utilities
#DES Open an editor (EDI PREF opens preferences).

#CMD EFL
#ALS EFL
#SYN EFL = v | EFL v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Effective focal length merit entry (constraint with =, or operand with target v, weight w).

#CMD EFX
#ALS EFX
#SYN EFX [Si..j] = v | EFX [Si..j] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Effective focal length in the X-Z plane (equal to EFY: torics are not traced).

#CMD EFY
#ALS EFY
#SYN EFY [Si..j] = v | EFY [Si..j] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Effective focal length of the system or of surfaces Si..j (Y-Z plane).

#CMD ELEV
#ALS ELEV
#SYN ELEV a
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Set the elevation angle of the 3D lens view.

#CMD ENGINETEST
#ALS ENGINETEST
#SYN ENGINETEST [BRIEF]
#CAT Diagnostics
#DES Unit test of the pure surface-placement transforms against the legacy ones.  For the current lens, runs a fixed set of rays through legacy TRNSF2 and place_into_surface at every surface NEWOBJ+1..NEWIMG, and the same points through BAKONE/FORONEL and their ports on surface NEWOBJ+1, comparing results bit for bit.  Also runs every surface's clear aperture / obscuration check (legacy CACHEK) against its port, check_apertures, over a grid of points, comparing the return code and every value CACHEK leaves behind.  Also compares the ray-aiming leaf routines (compute_aim_target/APLANA, GETZEE1, RAYDERIV, NEWDEL, MISSREF, adjustLastSurface) with their ports in mod_ray_aiming, bit for bit.  BRIEF prints only counts and verdicts.

#CMD ENP
#ALS ENP
#SYN ENP = v | ENP v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Paraxial entrance pupil position from S1.

#CMD EPD
#ALS EPD
#SYN EPD X
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Set the entrance pupil diameter to X.

#CMD ERR
#ALS ERR
#SYN ERR CDV|USR|BTH|CON
#CAT Optimization
#DES AUT: the error function -- CDV the CODE V error function (weighted RMS transverse ray aberration over a pupil grid, all fields and wavelengths), USR the objective terms you defined (NAME targ weight), BTH both, CON constraints only (least change of the variables).  Without ERR: your terms if any, otherwise CDV.

#CMD ET
#ALS ET
#SYN ET Sk = v | ET Sk v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Edge thickness after surface Sk, at the larger of the two semi-diameters.

#CMD ETH
#ALS ETH
#SYN ETH Sk X
#CAT Apertures
#DES Set the edge thickness aperture used by the MNE/MAE general constraints.

#CMD EVA
#ALS EVA
#SYN EVA name [qualifiers]
#CAT Analysis
#DES Evaluate a merit operand (with its Sk/Si..j/Wm/Fk/Ri/Zn qualifiers, as in AUT) and print its value.

#CMD EXP
#ALS EXP
#SYN EXP = v | EXP v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Paraxial exit pupil position from the last surface before the image.

#CMD EXPORTPNG
#ALS EXPORTPNG
#SYN EXPORTPNG file.png
#CAT Plotting
#DES Write the plot on the active tab to a PNG, straight from the surface it is drawn on -- i.e. exactly what is on screen, at the size the window is using.  GUI only.

#CMD FAB
#ALS FAB
#SYN FAB; [SUR Y] [IND Y] [SPA Y] [SAG [Sk] [max incr ref delta min]] [BES Y] [FRI Y] [SLO Y]; GO
#CAT Analysis
#DES Fabrication data: element (or surface) listing, index and spacer tables, aspheric sag tables (CODE V FAB).

#CMD FALLBACK
#ALS FALLBACK
#SYN FALLBACK
#CAT Utilities
#DES Report the legacy-command fallback tally (retirement telemetry).

#CMD FAN
#ALS FAN
#SYN FAN
#CAT Plotting
#DES Ray-fan plot (used within a plot loop).

#CMD FFO
#ALS FFO
#SYN FFO first_focus_position
#CAT System Parameters
#DES First focus position of the through-focus range, along the axis from the image surface (default 0).  SPO draws its spots at this focus; SPO THF at each of the NFO positions FFO, FFO+IFO, ...  Bare FFO shows it.

#CMD FIE
#ALS FIE
#SYN FIE
#CAT Plotting
#DES Astigmatic field-curvature and distortion plot.

#CMD FIO
#ALS FIO
#SYN FIO
#CAT Analysis
#DES Print the results of the first-order (paraxial) ray trace.

#CMD FLOAT
#ALS FLOAT
#SYN FLOAT
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Make the entrance pupil float with the stop surface's clear aperture.

#CMD FLY
#ALS FLY
#SYN FLY Si..j
#CAT Lens System Commands
#DES Flip (reverse) the given range of surfaces.

#CMD FMA
#ALS FMA
#SYN FMA; [FFD RWE|RSD|DST [Y]] [NFX n] [NFY n] [XMI v] [XMA v] [YMI v] [YMA v] [NRD n] [LIS Y]; GO
#CAT Analysis
#DES Field map: RMS wavefront, RMS spot diameter or distortion on a grid of field points (CODE V FMA FFD).

#CMD FNO
#ALS FNO
#SYN FNO [f | ?]
#CAT System Parameters
#DES Set (and hold) the image-space F/number, or report it.

#CMD FOO
#ALS FOO
#SYN FOO; [SUR Sk|Si..j] [BOU Y|N] [NRD n] [RAR f] [AZI min max incr] [DAP Y|N] [ORI x y] [LIS Y]; GO
#CAT Analysis
#DES Footprint plot: every field's beam where it crosses the designated surfaces, with the aperture outline (CODE V FOO).

#CMD FRE
#ALS FRE
#SYN FRE x
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES MTF THF: the spatial frequency whose modulation is plotted through focus.

#CMD FRZ
#ALS FRZ
#SYN FRZ
#CAT Optimization
#DES Freeze all variables (clear optimization variable codes).

#CMD GENCON
#ALS GENCON
#SYN GENCON YES|NO
#CAT Optimization
#DES Turn the general constraints (MXT/MNT/MNE/MNA/MAE) on or off; bare GENCON queries. Set inside AUT or UPD CON.

#CMD GLA
#ALS GLA
#SYN GLA Sk name
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Sets the glass at surface Sk to the named material. Searches through available glass catalogs for the name. Use a numeric nd,vd pair (e.g. 1.5,50) to specify a model glass.

#CMD GLC
#ALS GLC
#SYN GLC Sk n
#CAT Optimization
#DES Set the glass variable code on surface(s).

#CMD GLI
#ALS GLI
#SYN GLI [catalog]
#CAT Glass Catalogs
#DES Lists the catalog glasses' refractive indices at the lens wavelengths, one line per glass ('-' outside a glass's wavelength range).  Without a catalog, every catalog in search order (CSO).

#CMD GPR
#ALS GPR
#SYN GPR [catalog [glass]]
#CAT Glass Catalogs
#DES Lists all data (GLI, TLI and MLI) for one glass, or for the glasses of a catalog, or of every catalog.

#CMD GSC
#ALS GSC
#SYN GSC [Sj]
#CAT Tilts and Decenters
#DES List every surface's global position (X Y Z) and orientation (ADE BDE CDE, degrees) relative to surface Sj (default S1).

#CMD HELP
#ALS HEL HELP
#SYN HELP|HEL [command | INDX | category | text*]
#CAT Utilities
#DES Help for the Zoa commands: HELP alone lists the categories, HELP INDX every command, HELP RDY one command's syntax and description, HELP Plotting a category's commands, HELP SP* the commands starting with SP.  The text comes from help/commands.txt, which help/gen_docs.py makes from the documentation in the source.

#SYN I Sk c1 c2 ...
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Set the aspheric (4th..) coefficients of surface Sk.  $z = \dfrac{c r^2}{1+\sqrt{1-(1+k)c^2 r^2}}$.

#CAT Optimization

#CMD MCO
#ALS MCO
#SYN MCO Sk Cj value
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module aberration, in waves (reference wavelength) at the edge of the pupil and field: C11 spherical, C12 coma, C13 astigmatism, C14 distortion, C15 field curvature; C1-C3 axial and C6-C8 lateral colour at the MWL wavelengths.

#CMD MED
#ALS MED
#SYN MED Sk d
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module entrance pupil diameter.  Needed for MCO.

#CMD MEN
#ALS MEN
#SYN MEN Sk d
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module front vertex to entrance pupil (default 0).

#CMD MFD
#ALS MFD
#SYN MFD Sk [IMG] value
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module maximum field: object-space angle in degrees, or the image height with IMG.  Needed for MCO.

#CMD MFF
#ALS MFF
#SYN MFF Sk d
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module front vertex to front focal point (default -MFL).

#CMD MFL
#ALS MFL

#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module focal length (required).

#CMD MFR

#CMD MLI

#DES Lists the catalog glasses' other data: glass code, nd, vd, status, density, thermal expansion, partial dispersion deviation, relative cost and the climate, stain, acid, alkali and phosphate resistance codes ('-' where the catalog gives none).

#CMD MNT
#ALS MNT

#CAT Optimization

#CMD MOD
#ALS MOD
#SYN MOD Sk  |  MOD
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Make surfaces Sk and Sk+1 a lens module: a "black box" lens given by its first-order properties (MFL, MFF, MBF), perfect for an object at infinity, with the aberrations set by MCO. Both surfaces are made flat and the gap air.  MOD alone lists the modules.  CHR/ACH and finite conjugates (MRD) are not yet supported.

#CMD MRD
#ALS MRD
#SYN MRD Sk 0
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module reduction ratio; only 0 (object at infinity) is supported so far.

#CMD MTF
#ALS MTF
#SYN MTF [FRQ | THF] [Pn]
#CAT Plotting
#DES Modulation-transfer-function plot: vs frequency at focus FFO (FRQ, the default), or at one frequency (FRE) through the focus positions FFO/IFO/NFO (THF).

#CMD MULTIPLOT
#ALS MULTIPLOT
#SYN MULTIPLOT rows cols ['title'] [Pn]
#CAT Plotting
#DES Start a page of subplots (rows x cols cells, up to 6 x 6).  Each analysis that follows (RIM, SPO, MTF, PSF, ... ; GO) fills the next cell, or the one SUBPLOT chose; a GO with no analysis open draws the page.  The page redraws when the lens changes.

#CMD MWL
#ALS MWL
#SYN MWL Sk w1 w2 w3
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Lens module wavelengths (nm) of the MCO colour coefficients C1-C3 and C6-C8 (default 656.27 587.56 486.13).

#CMD NUMRINGS
#ALS NUMRINGS
#SYN NUMRINGS n
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Spot diagram: number of rings when the tracing method is RING, 1-50 (default 20).  The pattern is evenly spaced radii with six more rays on each successive ring.

#CMD OAL
#ALS OAL
#SYN OAL [Si..j] = v | OAL [Si..j] v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Distance from Si to Sj (thicknesses Si..j-1; default S1 to the last surface before the image).

#CMD OBS
#ALS OBS
#SYN OBS fraction
#CAT Optimization
#DES AUT: CDV leaves out rays inside this fraction of the pupil radius (a central obscuration; default 0).

#CMD ORIENT
#ALS ORIENT
#SYN ORIENT ...
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Set the orientation (elevation/azimuth) of the lens view.

#CMD PIK
#ALS PIK
#SYN PIK XXX Sk [YYY] Sj [A [B]]  |  PIK PRO Sk Sj [A]  |  PIK DEC Sk Sj [A]
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Pickup: parameter XXX (RDY, THI, K, A..I, GLA) of surface Sk follows parameter YYY (default XXX) of Sj, times A plus B.  PRO picks up the whole profile (curvature, conic, aspheric terms; A = -1 negates it), DEC the decenters and tilts (times A).  DEL PIK removes pickups.

#CMD PKL
#ALS PKL
#SYN PKL [Sk|Si..j]
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES List the pickups on the given surfaces (default all).

#CMD PLO
#ALS PLO
#SYN PLO SUR | BAR
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA plot type: SUR = OPD surface map (default), BAR = bar chart of the Fringe Zernike coefficients fitted to the wavefront.

#CMD PLO FOC
#ALS PLO
#SYN PLO FOC [Y|N]  |  PLO FRE [Y|N]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Inside MTF: PLO FOC Y charts the modulation at one frequency (FRE) through the focus positions FFO/IFO/NFO (same as MTF THF); PLO FRE Y (or PLO FOC N) charts it against frequency, the default. The field and NRD choices made so far are kept.

#DES Third-order (Seidel) aberration bar chart.

#CMD PRT

#CMD PRV
#ALS PRV
#SYN PRV
#CAT Glass Catalogs
#DES Starts private glass entries, which belong to the lens and are found before any catalog glass of the same name: PWL wavelength_nm ...       wavelengths for the next glasses 'label' index ...           a glass's index at each PWL wavelength END                         ends the entries One wavelength gives a constant index; more give a cubic spline over their range.  DEL PRV ALL|'label' removes them.

#SYN PSF
#CAT Plotting
#DES Point-spread-function plot.

#CAT Optimization

#CMD PTZ
#ALS PTZ
#SYN PTZ = v | PTZ v [w]
#CAT Optimization
#DES Petzval-curvature merit entry (1/R of the Petzval surface, lens units^-1).

#CMD RAD
#ALS RAD
#SYN RAD ; [NRD n] ; [PER p1 p2 ...] ; GO
#CAT Plotting
#DES Geometric radial (encircled) energy, CODE V's RAD option: plots the energy enclosed vs radius for each field and lists the radius enclosing each percentage, about the polychromatic spot's centroid.  NRD rays across the pupil (default 20); PER up to 10 percentages (default 10, 20, .. 100).

#CMD RAN COL
#ALS RAN
#SYN RAN COL SPE | RGB [r [g [b]]]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA: colour scale -- spectral rainbow (SPE, the default) or a ramp from black to the colour r g b (0..1 each; RGB 1 1 1 is grey).

#CMD RAY
#ALS RAY
#SYN RAY Rk Fj x y
#CAT Optimization
#DES AUT: define user reference ray Rk (R6..R9) of field Fj at relative pupil x, y, for ray constraints (Y R6 F3 SI = 0).

#CMD RAYENGINE
#ALS RAYENGINE
#SYN RAYENGINE [ON | OFF | CHECK]
#CAT Diagnostics
#DES Chooses the tracer CAPFN and the spot diagram (SPD, SPO, and the plots built on them) use. ON (default): the global-free ray trace engine, for any lens it supports, else the legacy tracer.  OFF: always the legacy tracer.  CHECK: trace with both and compare everything they store, printing "RAYENGINE CHECK: rows N, mismatches M" (CAPFN) or "RAYENGINE CHECK (SPOT): rows N, mismatches M". The legacy RAYTRA/RAYTRA2 entry points (ray fans, the RAY family, footprints ...) follow the same setting, ray by ray; with no argument RAYENGINE reports the setting and how many of those calls the engine took, CHECK compared and declined.  RAYENGINE RESET zeroes those counters.

#CMD RAYREF
#ALS RAYREF
#SYN RAYREF
#CAT Analysis
#DES Compute the per-field reference rays (R1..R5).

#CMD RDY
#ALS RDY
#SYN RDY Sk X
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Sets the radius of surface Sk to X. Sk can be S0 (object), S1..SN (surface by number), or Si (current surface). X is the new radius value in current lens units.

#CMD RECMACRO

#CAT Utilities
#DES Record a macro: 1 starts recording the commands you issue; 0 file stops and saves them (macro folder if no directory, .zoa added); 0 alone asks for the file (GUI); bare reports the status.

#CMD REX

#SYN REX|REY|ELX|ELY|ADX|ADY|ARO [OBS] [Sk|Si..j] value
#CAT Apertures
#DES Clear aperture (or, with OBS, obscuration) of surface Sk (default: the current surface): REX/REY rectangle and ELX/ELY ellipse X/Y semi-widths, ADX/ADY its decenter, ARO its rotation (degrees).  CIR OBS r is a circular obscuration.

#CMD RIM
#ALS RIM
#SYN RIM
#CAT Plotting
#DES Ray-aberration (rim-ray fan) plot.  WFR Y plots the wave aberration (OPD, waves) instead.

#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Set the surface Sk mode: reflector, refractor (air), or TIR reflector.

#CMD RMSDATA

#SYN RMSDATA WAVE|SPOT
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Choose the data type for the RMS-vs-field plot.

#CMD ROF
#ALS ROF
#SYN ROF [item ...] ['Fw.d']
#CAT Analysis
#DES Ray output format for RSI and SIN: the items listed per surface -- X Y Z (intersection), L M N (direction cosines after the surface), TNX TNY (direction tangents), AOI AOR (angles of incidence and refraction, degrees), LEN (path length from the previous surface), SRL SRM SRN (surface normal) -- and the number format ('F12.8'). ROF alone restores the defaults (RSI's X Y Z XANG YANG listing; SIN lists X Y Z TNX TNY LEN).

#CMD RSI
#ALS RSI
#SYN RSI [Fk|Fi..j] [Wn] XR YR  |  RSI Fk Rs  |  RSI [Wn] XR YR thXR thYR
#CAT Analysis
#DES Trace a single ray and list it surface by surface (see ROF). XR YR are relative pupil coordinates; without Fk the ray is on axis, without Wn at the reference wavelength (CODE V's defaults).  Rs (R1..R5) is a reference ray of field Fk, vignetting included; thXR thYR give a relative field.

#CMD RSL
#ALS RSL
#SYN RSL [INF | DEF | radius]
#CAT System Parameters
#DES OPD reference sphere: DEF (default) radius from the exit pupil for each field; INF flat reference; radius = that radius for every field (positive: sphere before the image).  Bare RSL shows the setting.

#CMD RSPH
#ALS RSPH
#SYN RSPH [CHIEF | NOTILT | BEST]
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES Reference sphere centre for wavefront calculations. Inside a plot (e.g. PLTRMS) it sets that plot's own Reference setting, applied only while the plot computes. At the top level it sets the global default, as the legacy KDP command did.  With no qualifier it reports the current global setting.

#CMD S
#ALS S S0 SO
#SYN S [rd th glass]
#CAT Surface Parameters
#DES Advance to / add the next surface (optionally set radius, thickness, glass).

#CMD SAP
#ALS MER SAG SAP
#SYN SAP|MER|SAG [Y|N]
#CAT Optimization
#DES AUT: the CDV ray pattern -- SAP the full square grid, MER only the meridional (Y) fan, SAG only the sagittal (X) fan.  N restores the default circular grid of skew rays.

#CMD SCA
#ALS SCA
#SYN SCA FAC|OAL|TT|EFL|EFY|EFX [Si..j] [SPC] value  |  SCA DIM I|C|M  |  SCA SPC
#CAT Lens System Commands
#DES Scale the lens, or the segment Si..j: FAC by a factor (negative flips it), OAL to that overall length (Si..Sj vertices), TT to that total track, EFL/EFY/EFX to that focal length (of the segment, with Si..j).  The specification data (EPD, object heights) is scaled too only with SPC; SCA SPC scales it by the last factor afterwards. SCA DIM I|C|M converts the lens and its specification data to inches, centimetres or millimetres.

Opens a data tab that updates with the lens.

#CMD SET

#CMD SINRAYTRA

#CMD THO

#SYN THO
#CAT Analysis
#DES List the third-order aberrations as CODE V does: transverse SA TCO TAS SAS PTB DST, and AX LAT (axial and lateral colour, longest to shortest wavelength) for more than one wavelength, by surface and summed.  With no off-axis field the field terms are for CODE V's default field, tan 0.02.

#CMD THREADS
#ALS THREADS
#SYN THREADS [n]
#CAT Utilities
#DES Number of CPU threads the CAPFN ray grid (wavefront, spot, MTF and PSF calculations) is traced with.  n = 0 is automatic (all cores), n = 1 is serial.  With no argument, reports the current setting and the number of threads that will be used.  The setting is saved as a preference.  Results do not depend on the thread count.

Traces an n x n pupil grid (default 8) at wavelength slot w (default: reference wavelength) for the current lens and field with both tracers and compares status codes and the per-surface ray data.  Run FOB first.  BRIEF prints only deterministic counts and the PASS/FAIL/SKIP verdict.

#SYN YRI h1 [h2 ...]   (XRI for X)
#CAT Fields & Wavelengths
#DES Set the Y real image heights (field specification).

#CMD ZFO
#ALS ZFO
#SYN ZFO Y|N
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES FIE: field curves measured from the axial focus instead of the image surface.

#CMD ZFR
#ALS ZFR
#SYN ZFR n
#CAT Plot Settings
#DES PMA: number of Zernike terms shown in the BAR chart and Data tab, 1-37 (default 37). The fit itself is always 37 terms.

#CMD ZINTEST
#ALS ZINTEST
#SYN ZINTEST
#CAT Diagnostics
#DES Self-check of the .zin plot-file serializer (writes and reads back every plot kind); used by the test suite.

#CMD ZLI
#ALS ZLI
#SYN ZLI
#CAT Zoom / Multi-Configuration
#DES List the zoom (multi-configuration) data; same as a bare ZOO.

#CMD ZOA2CV
#ALS ZOA2CV
#SYN ZOA2CV file
#CAT File I/O
#DES Export the current lens to a CODE V sequence (.seq) file.

#CMD ZOA2ZMX
#ALS ZOA2ZMX
#SYN ZOA2ZMX file
#CAT File I/O
#DES Export the current lens to a Zemax (.zmx) file.

#CMD ZOO
#ALS ZOO
#SYN ZOO ... | ZOO PIM
#CAT Zoom / Multi-Configuration
#DES Define zoom (multi-configuration) data.

#CMD ZRN
#ALS ZRN
#SYN ZRN WAV [fi] [wj] [zk] [dN]
#CAT Analysis
#DES Fit the OPD error to Zernike polynomials and print a 36-term coefficient table.

#CMD ZRNFLD
#ALS ZRNFLD
#SYN ZRNFLD ; [SETZERNC ...] ; GO
#CAT Plotting
#DES Zernike-coefficient-vs-field plot.
